artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the large dark bread loaf appears slightly 'mushy' or overly smooth in certain areas, lacking the crisp, irregular craggy detail expected of real rustic rye bread. It resembles a smoothed digital painting rather than photographic detail.
The small rolls in the middle ground seem to merge into each other without clear separation boundaries. The geometry between individual rolls is ambiguous, suggesting slight fusion or melting.
The long breads in the back right appear to warp slightly as they recede, losing structural rigidity. The perspective lines of the shelf also seem to bend subtly.
